candidates.tagline: They spent $14.6M painting the Reflecting Pool blue — then the paint left.
candidates.story: The Trump administration paid $14.6 million to renovate the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool and paint the floor and walls 'American flag blue'; within weeks the polyurea coating was peeling off in large floating chunks, algae bloomed green, and when visitors touched the floating flakes Trump blamed 'vandals' and ordered arrests.
candidates.why_funny: A renovation whose entire design premise was 'the pool should be blue' produced a pool that was blue for the wrong reasons — floating paint chips and algae — and the administration's response was to arrest tourists for touching the evidence.
candidates.alt: The Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool in Washington DC in June 2026 showing the newly painted blue floor with algae bloom and cleanup equipment visible on the pool edge following the controversial $14.6M renovation

candidates.tagline: Commodore made a $499 retro phone — then sold branded AliExpress tat for $24.
candidates.story: Commodore's Callback 8020 retro flip phone ($499, launched June 2026) is now joined by an official $24 'Backpack Holster' accessory — which fans immediately identified as a generic product sold on AliExpress for a fraction of the price with a Commodore logo slapped on, prompting one fan to call it 'one of the most embarrassingly awful things I've ever seen.'
candidates.why_funny: A company charging $499 for the premium nostalgia of owning a Commodore-branded flip phone apparently expected those same fans to pay $24 extra for what is functionally a rebranded fanny-pack from a bulk Chinese wholesaler.
candidates.alt: The official Commodore Callback 8020 Backpack Holster — a small transparent plastic backpack-style accessory with a Commodore logo, designed to carry the retro flip phone alongside a credit card or Walkman
